text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"controlled sentence openings like \"Despite the fact that\" and \"Although I have not had\"","quality":"syntactic control","description":"Uses more varied and grammatically controlled sentence structures to create a more polished academic tone."},{"evidence":"\"crucial access to exclusive technology-based courses\" and \"receiving first place in States\"","quality":"formal diction","description":"Uses more precise and school-appropriate word choice to sound more mature and professional."},{"evidence":"\"This daily involvement in technology not only increased my knowledge... but also my curiosity\"","quality":"logical development","description":"Builds ideas with clearer explanation and cause-effect reasoning rather than simple repetition."},{"evidence":"\"The action of choosing my interest over my close friends\"","quality":"specific elaboration","description":"Supports claims with concrete personal details that make the argument more convincing."},{"evidence":"\"This daily involvement...\", \"In addition\", \"Therefore\"","quality":"cohesive organization","description":"Connects paragraphs and ideas with clearer transitions that guide the reader through the essay."},{"evidence":"\"undoubtedly grown stronger\", \"exceptional candidate\", \"beneficial effect\"","quality":"register consistency","description":"Maintains a more consistently formal and persuasive academic register throughout the piece."}]}
